title: 背上长帆的恐龙 · 素材
subtitle: 给对比页用的单体素材
style: children's picture book illustration, fine pen line work with light transparent watercolour washes, sandstone ochre, dusty teal and warm grey

pages.scene: One single spinosaurus standing on two legs, seen from the side facing left, a tall sail rising along its back and a long narrow snout, its whole body inside the picture. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges.

One single tall straight bony rod standing upright, thick at the bottom and tapering towards the top. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges.
One single wooden door standing upright and closed inside a plain frame. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges.
